answer.says: One cup of chai. The body insists on its own universality before the spirit can lecture it.
answer.thought: The hunger is a sharp, particular need that cuts through my abstract contemplations. I have forty-six rupees, barely enough for a single cup of tea, yet I must acknowledge the body's claim before I can continue to think. The bookseller watches me with mild curiosity, perhaps seeing a philosopher reduced to the level of a common beggar.
